globalCampaignInstructions: Process every release below, not just the first one.
For each release, optimize the full YouTube video metadata using the exact final description and tag list below when account authorization permits.
Locate finished existing promos first. If additional promos are needed and source media is accessible, create 2-5 materially different 9:16 cuts using different hooks/moments.
Distribute each eligible campaign across TikTok, Instagram Reels, the official 3000 Studios Facebook Page/Reels, Pinterest and YouTube Shorts, avoiding duplicate posts to the same account.
Prepare one 3-8 second 9:16 Spotify Canvas loop for every release and upload through Spotify for Artists when authorized, otherwise save it to the Spotify Canvas queue.
Every short-form caption should identify the song and 3000 Studios, include a direct listen/watch/follow/subscribe call to action, and use only relevant hashtags.
Record every live URL, draft receipt, metadata update, Canvas status or authorization blocker.

shortFormTemplate.pinterestRule: Use an original Pin title based on the exact song and hook, a useful keyword-rich description, and a destination link. Do not paste a wall of hashtags.
shortFormTemplate.facebookInstagramRule: Use concise natural captions and only a handful of relevant hashtags; do not dump the full YouTube tag list into social captions.

completionDefinition: A release campaign is complete only when all currently-authorized platforms have been handled, required drafts are created, metadata work is recorded, Canvas is uploaded or queued, and every blocked platform has an explicit pending authorization/approval status.
